summary: Stay compliant with our industrial hygiene training course. Learn the regulatory requirements to protect your workforce and improve safety standards.
lede: Industrial hygiene regulatory training explains how to identify workplace exposures and apply requirements for assessing and controlling them. Designed for professionals in industrial hygiene, occupational health, operations, and compliance, it covers interpreting exposure limits, planning and documenting monitoring, selecting controls, and preparing records for inspections and audits.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for industrial hygiene, occupational health, and regulatory compliance, regularly dealing with exposure risks and safety decisions.
audience: HSE or EHS managers and advisors
Industrial hygiene officers and occupational health practitioners
Plant managers and operations managers in high-risk
Compliance officers and internal auditors for health
modules: Foundations of Industrial Hygiene and Regulatory Context
Legal and Regulatory Framework for Industrial Hygiene
Hazard Identification and Exposure Assessment Requirements
Control Measures and the Hierarchy of Controls in Law and Practice
Monitoring, Sampling, and Documentation for Compliance
Regulatory Reporting, Medical Surveillance, and Recordkeeping
Contractors, Supply Chain, and Multi-Employer Worksites
Building and Sustaining a Compliant Industrial Hygiene Program
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of workplace safety and health principles and familiarity with industry-specific operational processes.
